item.title: Syed Ata Hasnain | After Khamenei: Mideast Is At Strategic Crossroads
item.description: Yet, even at this dramatic moment, one question demands clarity: does removing a “supreme leader” amount to removing the regime? Operationally, the strikes reflect formidable intelligence penetration and precision capability. Identifying hardened leadership locations, tracking movements, and neutralising targets with calibrated force imply sustained surveillance and coordinated strike architecture

item.title: Aakar Patel | Myths & Reality Over 'Love Jihad’: Why All This Fuss On Conversions?
item.description: Remember that this is the state whose high court, in December 2009, announced it suspected a “plan to trap brilliant upper-caste Hindu and Christian girls from well-to-do-families”. This casual remark, made by a judge who accepted that he had no evidence, began the conspiracy theory of “love jihad” which remains with us today
